name: comment.reply
description: The team answers a guest's comment, signed as the brand.
sql:
insert into brandbase.comments as r (id, brand_id, kind, target_id, parent_id, name, from_team, text, created_at)
select gen_random_uuid()::text, c.brand_id, c.kind, c.target_id, c.id, b.name, true, btrim(:text), :now::timestamptz
from brandbase.comments c join brandbase.brands b on b.id = c.brand_id where c.id = :id and c.brand_id = :brand
returning brandbase.camel(to_jsonb(r)) || jsonb_build_object('createdAt', brandbase.iso(r.created_at)) as result
